welcome.noFolder:
Open a folder to get started.
CLI Grid is configured per folder, like .vscode/settings.json.
[Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)
config.defaultMode: Whether the launcher starts a CLI fresh or resumes its previous conversation by default. Individual profiles and individual agents can override it. CLI Grid never manages conversation state itself; it only chooses which arguments to pass.
config.launchStrategy: `shell` runs your login shell and types the command into it, so CLIs installed via nvm, mise or `~/.local/bin` resolve correctly. `exec` runs the executable directly, which reports the exit code more accurately but requires the command to be on the extension host's `PATH`.
config.launchStrategy.shell: Run through a login shell (more compatible)
config.launchStrategy.exec: Execute the command directly (accurate exit codes)
config.autoStart: Start the folder's agents as soon as it is opened. Off by default so that opening a folder never launches a CLI you did not ask for.
config.profiles: CLI profiles shown in the launcher. Entries are merged over the built-in defaults for `claude`, `codex` and `gemini`; set `hidden` to `true` to remove one. Arguments are passed through untouched.
walkthrough.title: Get Started with CLI Grid
walkthrough.description: Run several coding agents side by side without losing track of which repository each one is in.
walkthrough.step1.title: Open a folder
walkthrough.step1.description:
CLI Grid is configured per folder. Open one the normal way — there is nothing else to set up.
[Open Folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)
walkthrough.step2.title: Add an agent
walkthrough.step2.description:
Pick the folder the CLI should run in, then pick the CLI. The choice is written to .vscode/cli-grid.json so it comes back next time.
[New Agent](command:cliGrid.newAgent)
walkthrough.step3.title: Arrange the grid
walkthrough.step3.description: Pick a split in the Layout section — 2 × 1, 2 × 2, 3 × 2 and so on. The choice is saved with the project.

config.lockAgentPanes: Lock the panes that hold an agent, so files opened from anywhere — the Files view, quick open, go to definition — land in the pane beside the grid instead of on top of a running CLI. Dragging a tab into a pane yourself still works.
